records.authors: Claire de Mazancourt; Michel Loreau; Ulf Dieckmann
records.title: Understanding mutualism when there is adaptation to the partner
records.mechanism: evolved dependence vs proximate mutualism vs ultimate benefit
records.claim: Current partner-dependence is not equivalent to counterfactual long-term benefit
records.countercase: A formerly harmful interaction can become obligate following coadaptation
records.limitations: Evolutionary ecology argument; ultimate effects difficult to measure; no human/AI right testing

records.authors: Diana E Marco; Juan P Carbajal; Sergio Cannas; Rebeca Pérez-Arnedo; Ángeles Hidalgo-Perea; José Olivares; José E Ruiz-Sainz; Juan Sanjuán
records.title: An experimental and modelling exploration of the host-sanction hypothesis in legume-rhizobia mutualism
records.mechanism: sanction absent under measured indicators; persistence without sanctions in specified model
records.claim: Certain rhizobium-host populations can persist despite cheaters under some conditions
records.countercase: Kiers 2003 reports a sanction-like response under another intervention
records.limitations: Not same-protocol independent replication of Kiers; full original PDF/independent model rerun not completed

records.authors: E Glen Weyl; Megan E Frederickson; Douglas W Yu; Naomi E Pierce
records.title: Economic contract theory tests models of mutualism
records.same_work_preprint_title: Are Mutualisms Maintained by Host Sanctions or Partner Fidelity Feedback?
records.mechanism: partner fidelity feedback as alternative to costly host sanction
records.claim: Coevolutionary model plus re-reading prior empirical cases favors PFF in specified conditions
records.countercase: Kiers et al 2011 question definition of host sanctions and biological realism
records.limitations: Model plus interpreted prior data, not a new experimental test; formal proof not independently audited

records.title: Negotiation, Sanctions, and Context Dependency in the Legume-Rhizobium Mutualism
records.claim: Apparent increased host choice may worsen outcome; sanctions alone insufficient for cooperation
records.countercase: Outside-option improvement and effective choice are not monotone across bargaining conditions
records.limitations: Theoretical ecological bargaining model; not field causal proof or a finding about AI rights

records.authors: Stephanie S Porter; Ellen L Simms
records.title: Selection for cheating across disparate environments in the legume-rhizobium mutualism
records.mechanism: selection for exploitation in forced single-pair host/symbiont pairing
records.claim: Rhizobia cheating favored across contrasting environments in observed system
records.countercase: Stable-looking mutualism need not imply selection for unconditional cooperation
records.limitations: Single partner pairing blocks partner choice; statistical full text and raw data not checked

records.title: Indirect reciprocity and strategic reputation building in an experimental helping game
records.mechanism: pure indirect reciprocity vs strategic reputation
records.claim: Pure indirect reciprocity observed while strategic concerns still substantially influence helping decisions
records.countercase: Removal of reputation-building option does not remove all prosocial incentive or identify B-preservation value
records.limitations: Experiment design/sample/full paper not independently reviewed

records.title: The biological reality of host sanctions and partner fidelity
records.claim: Objection to Weyl et al 2010's interpretation and biological assumptions

records.title: Reply to Kiers et al.: Economic and biological clarity in the theory of mutualism
